name: Nerima
tagline: Shinjuku in 19 minutes and Shibuya in 29 minutes. Served by 4 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Nerima City, where Seibu and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 4 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 35 minutes to Otemachi, 19 minutes to Shinjuku, 29 minutes to Shibuya and 50 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 40 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 5.2 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 40 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 35.2 m to 40.4 m, a difference of 5.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: まいばすけっと 練馬駅南店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 14 clinics and 15 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 秀佑会東海病院, about 18 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 総合東京病院, about 23 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 4 lines serve the station. Seibu Ikebukuro Line run through it. Seibu Yurakucho Line and Seibu Toshima Line also call here. Toei Oedo Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (Seibu runs 3 lines and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Toei Oedo Line runs at 147% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is not on. Seibu Ikebukuro Line runs at 130%. Its busiest stretch is 椎名町→池袋, which this station is likewise not on. Seibu Yurakucho Line runs at 102%. Its busiest stretch is 新桜台→小竹向原, which this station is likewise not on. Seibu Toshima Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For quiet, Toshimaen; for rail connections, Nerima.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nerima. Toshimaen has only the Seibu Toshima Line and Toei Oedo Line, so Nerima is the better connected. To Tokyo, for instance, Toshimaen takes 5 minutes longer. On quiet, though, Toshimaen comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For quiet, Sakuradai; for rail connections, Nerima.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nerima. Sakuradai has only the Seibu Ikebukuro Line, so Nerima is the better connected. To Roppongi, for instance, Sakuradai takes 7 minutes longer. On quiet, though, Sakuradai comes out ahead.

noiseSources: 千川通り (1 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 14 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 4 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
